rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N serves as the primary join key to Acc_Info_dirty and must be populated for referential integrity

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N; every record must have a matching parent record

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Account numbers are 4-digit identifiers (range 1001-1028) intended to be stored as strings; values must maintain 4-character length

rule: Name must follow Title Case convention (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Sample shows one lowercase value 'lim wei jie' and one all-caps value 'WANG SHI JIE' that deviate from the dominant Title Case pattern; particles like Bin, Binte, s/o, d/o should remain lowercase

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match the Gender column (Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female)
rationale: Malay and Indian naming conventions use specific particles to indicate gender: 'Bin' and 's/o' (son of) indicate male, while 'Binte' and 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female; mismatches suggest data quality issues

check_params.logic: ((' Bin ' in ' ' + str(row['Name']) + ' ' or ' s/o ' in ' ' + str(row['Name']) + ' ') and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or ((' Binte ' in ' ' + str(row['Name']) + ' ' or ' d/o ' in ' ' + str(row['Name']) + ' ') and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: ID_No must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: Evidence shows 93.3% of values conform to this format; 6.6% deviate with missing prefix ('1916569C') or only 6 digits ('F212233V')

rule: ID_No must be unique across the dataset
rationale: National ID numbers should uniquely identify individuals; evidence shows one duplicate value 'F1011121T' that requires investigation

rule: ID_No must exactly match the corresponding ID value in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: Cross-table semantic consistency requires that the identification number stored in the bio table matches the account info table for the same customer record

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must exactly match the ID value in the sibling table after joining on S_N

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows only these three semantic categories with case variations (MALAY, malay, indian); standardizing to Title Case enumeration

rule: Gender must be either Male or Female
rationale: Evidence shows two semantic categories with case variations (male, FEMALE); binary flag requiring standardization to Title Case

rule: Age must be parseable as a numeric value
rationale: Evidence shows one text value 'Twenty-five' that cannot be parsed as a number; all age values must be numeric

rule: Age must be an integer without decimal places
rationale: Sample contains '60.0' indicating a decimal value; ages should be whole numbers

rule: Age must be between 13 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Domain constraint for service account eligibility (minimum 13) and realistic human lifespan (maximum 120); evidence flags values -5 and 4 as unrealistic

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is essential for customer communication; evidence shows 6.7% missing values that require validation as per recommended actions

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number (8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9, optionally prefixed with +65 or 65)
rationale: Evidence shows Singapore country code (+65) and local 8-digit formats; one truncated 7-digit value '8964359' requires flagging

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 4 malformed emails: missing @ ('not-an-email', 'useremail.com'), space before @ ('zx91 @example.com'), and double @ ('nabilah@@example.com')

rule: Email must be in lowercase
rationale: Per email standardization guidelines, emails must be lowercased to ensure consistency; mixed-case emails should be flagged for standardization

rule: Country must be standardized to 'Singapore'
rationale: Evidence shows 8 variations of Singapore (SINGAPORE, singapore, S'pore, SG, Singapura, 新加坡, Republic of Singapore); all must standardize to canonical form

rule: Street_Name must not be in all uppercase
rationale: Evidence shows one all-caps value 'HOLLAND ROAD' among 29 Title Case values; standardization to Title Case required

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Singapore postal codes are strictly 6 digits; evidence shows 4-digit (6907) and 5-digit (99999) values that may be missing leading zeros or invalid

rule: Name must be consistent with Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty (accounting for case, whitespace, and standardization of particles)
rationale: Cross-table semantic consistency requires that the customer name in the bio table matches the corresponding name in the account info table after normalizing case and whitespace; discrepancies like 'Danish Bin Kamaruddin' vs 'Danish' require review

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name after normalizing case, whitespace, and known particles (Bin, Binte, s/o, d/o)

rule: S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
rationale: One-to-one key relationship detected by MinHash analysis; duplicate values break the join.

rule: Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['thm@example.com'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.
